notes: Source 2 (Finkelstein 1997 p. 653) names no candidate feature. No SWP entry in packet. E177 is a second WBADB row for the same site at 0 m; its silos and cistern are coded with grid E177 as the brief requires. Source 4 positions use the area locations the report gives relative to the tell: Area C western slope (p. 130), Area M northern part (p. 155), Area K 'in the north' (p. 128), Area D northeast (p. 140), Area H northwestern sector (p. 142), Danish southern sector (p. 125), Area E 50 m east of the summit (p. 157, relative_to other). Silo in Area H (f22) is from the report text visible on the p. 150 plan image, not in the excerpts. No plan positions: plans use a local excavation grid and Fig. 2 has no north arrow, so the WBADB point cannot be placed. 'Ein Seilun spring 900 m NE (p. 125) is called a spring, not a pool; not coded from source 4. Byzantine plastered two-compartment installation in Area C (p. 139) treated as an industrial vat, not coded. The packet's burial excerpt says the report has no burial passage; that is silence, not an absence statement. S1459 'several tombs nearby' gives no tomb type, so cavity_with_opening=false.
